series.title: Gouvt. Sumatra Res. Atjeh en Onderh
series.notes: Topographic map series of Aceh region, Indonesia showing roads, tracks, footpaths, boundaries, water features, vegetation, cultivation, swamps, buildings and built-up areas. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. | Japanese copies of Dutch maps. | Includes bladindeeling, administrative index and schets anngevende de meetlijnen.

creator: Netherlands. Topografische Dienst, cartographer. issuing body.
